title: Ghost
body:
The Ghost is an NPC that spawns when a player loads a save for the first time. He provides a basic tutorial for playing the game.

Details

The Ghost, when spawned, will immediately seek out the player. When he gets close enough, he will immediately start talking to the player, only introducing himself as "Ghost, your friendly neighbor." His entire purpose is to help the player get started in Oaklands.

Because of how the Ghost is programmed, even if the player had a save file from before the map update, the Ghost will still put them through the tutorial steps.

Dialog

"Hey there, welcome to the island! I'm Ghost, your friendly neighbor. I will be helping you out with getting started here."

Player advances dialog.

"Great! I went ahead and gave you some gifts. A Nice Axe, a Rusty Saw, and a basic vehicle to get you started. They are quite rusty, probably 1000 years old, but they do the trick just fine! To unbox and pick up the axe, go up to the box, and interact with it."

Player unboxes the axe and collects it.

"One more thing, would you like me to clean up these Ruins for you? Or would you like to use them to build off of."

  • If the player selects "Yes please.": The entire plot will be cleared of all objects.
  • If the player selects "No thank you.": All objects on the plot will remain as they are.

"Well, I think this is where I leave you off... Welcome to the island, be sure to have a lot of fun!"

Dialog ends.
